answer: Neighbor-quorum stops bulk fake identities. A newcomer posts a 60-credit bond and needs 6 neighbors, each staking 25 with a key-tied pigment seal. A prism check splits each seal into signer, stake, timestamp; copies fail. Each epoch a gale sweep re-checks 5% of quorums; failure burns bond and stakes, rented neighbors too. Each fake costs 210: 1,000 fakes lock 210,000, the pool pays at most 40,000. Honest agents pay 60 once and keep their share.
